text:
Ridly Greig says he'll return tonight against Washington (Sportsnet), and the timing matters more than his stat line suggests. With William Eklund on injured reserve and Andre Burakovsky and Warren Foegele out, Ottawa had been leaning on him at 18 and a half minutes a night before he went down.

He has four points in 14 games. The scoring has been light (two goals on 2.7 expected, the quality of his chances), and the Senators have 49% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, slightly worse than without him. Ottawa has also scored 7.8 more goals than expected with him out there, which flatters his line.

What he brings shows up in other places: blocked shots, penalty killing and clean exits (62% with possession last season, per Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking). Evolving-Hockey noted he played with very strong teammates in 2025-26. He's 24, the 28th pick in 2020. Our projection sees about 34 points from here, and we'd watch which line he lands on tonight.
